# Copilot Skills Catalog

These skills are organized for direct Copilot discovery under `.github/skills/`.

## Entry skills
- `ai-skills/` -> global routing and composition
- `auth-mode-router/` -> auth mode selection across stacks
- `nextjs-v16/` -> Next.js 16 wrapper
- `express-v5/` -> Express 5 wrapper
- `laravel-v12/` -> Laravel 12 wrapper

## Canonical source docs
The wrappers point to versioned source docs in:
- `nextjs/v16/*`
- `express/v5/*`
- `laravel/v12/*`
- `context.md`

Update canonical docs first when behavior changes, then keep wrapper summaries aligned.
